domains.statement: This accepted formalization covers Bubbleverse evidence authorized from Q001 through Q039 only; it includes no evidence beyond the authorized Q039 boundary.
The gaussian-tension operation is valid only as a simple independent-Gaussian marginal comparison; it is not a general joint-likelihood significance calculator.
The weighted-mean operation does not determine whether scientific inputs should be combined; suitability must be established outside the arithmetic operation.

Q039 excludes the tested relative-calibration, native off-diagonal precision, tested combination, and foreground-profiling blocks as sufficient single explanations under locked conditions; it does not identify a unique deeper cause.
The accepted CMB and DESI+BBN H0 benchmark numbers are inference-route outputs under their recorded flat-LCDM conditions; they are not universal model-independent measurements.
